senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to lead in council,] to preside; to officiate; to be ruler.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:5">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ שנה מונין לו שתים</he> when he has been in office one year, they date (in documents) ‘the second year’.
<cite ref="Megillah 11a:24">Meg. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>המֹלֵךְ</he>, <cite ref="Esther 1:1">Esth. I, 1</cite>) <he>מ׳ מעצמו</he> started a dynasty with himself (had no claims of succession).

<cite ref="Zevachim 118b:18">Zeb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>עשרה שנה שמ׳ וכ׳</he> ten years during which Samuel ruled alone, <he>ושנה שמ׳ שאול וכ׳</he> and one year during which Saul and Samuel ruled conjointly; <cite ref="Temurah 15a:1">Tem. 15ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to take council, to ask advice or permission.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3b:30">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>נִמְלָכִין בסנהדרין</he> they ask the Sanhedrin for their confirmation. Ib. 4ᵃ <he>כל מה … אני נ׳ במפיבשת וכ׳</he> in whatever I undertake, I consult the opinion of M., my teacher. Ib. 29ᵇ <he>וכשאתה … הִמָּלֵךְ בקונך וצא</he> and when thou art about to go on a journey, take council of thy Maker (pray) and go out.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 14a:6">B. Mets. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>צריך לִימָּלֵךְ</he> the scribe must ask for authorization (to insert in the contract); a. fr.

senses.gloss: [to take council with one’s self,] to reconsider, change one’s mind.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:2">Dem. III, 2</cite> <he>הלוקח … ונ׳ להחזיר</he> if one buys vegetables …. and then decides to return (the goods).
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>נטלן לאוכלן ונ׳ להצניע</he> if he took them up to eat them and changed his mind (deciding) to keep them; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to appoint or elect for rulership, to acknowledge the authority of.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:19">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שהִמְלִיכוּהוּ עליהם</he>, v. <cite ref="M00511"><he>מוֹלֶךְ</he></cite>. Y. Ned. IX, beg. 41ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 81:10">Ps. LXXXI, 10</cite>) <he>זר שבקרבך אל תַּמְלִיכֵהוּ עליך</he> allow not the tyrant within thee (the evil inclination) to rule over thee.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:6">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>אומה זו מן השמים הִמְלִיכוּהָ</he> this (Roman) nation has been given the rulership by divine decree.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:12">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אמרו לפני … מלכיות שתַּמְלִיכוּנִי עליכם</he> recite before me verses of homage (v. <cite ref="M01579"><he>מַלְכוּת</he></cite>), in order that you may declare me your ruler; a. fr.
